snippet.title: Instruments Of Power - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Shape powerful spells in this tactical RPG and channel them through disposable avatars. Reclaim ancient sites of power, unleash devastating magic, and uncover the truth about your enemies.
But whose war are you really fighting?
